name: prototype-product
job: Run a cheap real prototype with explicit hypothesis, probe, evidence, and go/kill/pivot decision.

inScope: Framing hypothesis and success signal with a time box
Researching only until it changes the probe
Building the lowest-cost falsifying or supporting probe
Recording observation and a go, kill, pivot, or next-probe decision
outOfScope: Production hardening, multi-region, and abstract platforms
Non-learning production work smuggled into the probe

inputs: Analogs, prior art, and in-repo history
Workspace for the probe and observation path
outputs: Minimum interactive or observable slice in the real workspace
Observation and decision with evidence pointers
Suggested next work kind (build, expand, or another prototype)
failureSemantics: Evidence is observation plus decision, not code existence; throwaway and placeholder elements are marked explicitly; the set stays finishable inside the time box.

outcome.observable: A real probe ran (or a concrete external blocker is named) and a written go, kill, pivot, or next-probe decision with evidence pointers was produced.
